n9fb9a3fe343.s: Under the Revised SHAKTI policy (May 2025), coal is allocated through how many windows?
n9fb9a3fe343.x: The Revised SHAKTI policy of May 2025 allocates coal through two windows.

n322ee18c633.s: Under PM Surya Ghar, a 1–3 kW rooftop solar system can provide up to how many free units per month?
n322ee18c633.x: A 1–3 kW system under PM Surya Ghar can provide up to 300 free units per month.

n76a59c10bee.s: Besides Tamil Nadu and Gujarat, which of the following is a major wind-energy State of India?
n76a59c10bee.x: India's wind-energy States are Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Andhra Pradesh; Odisha is not among them.

n45d7cbe8b96.s: Which grade of coal has the highest carbon content, about 80–95%?
n45d7cbe8b96.x: Anthracite has 80–95% carbon; bituminous has 40–80%, lignite about 40–50% and peat less than 40%.

n1ffb0890f22.s: Which of the following pairs of India's nuclear-programme stage and its basis is correctly matched?
o: Stage I – Enriched uranium in light-water reactors
Stage III – Enriched uranium in light-water reactors
n1ffb0890f22.x: Stage III is thorium-based (AHWR); Stage I uses PHWRs fuelled by natural uranium with heavy water as moderator.

nap-geography-16-27.s: What is the total capacity of the ReNew Power integrated project in Ananthapuram, Andhra Pradesh?
nap-geography-16-27.x: The project's total capacity is 2.8 GW; 1.8 GWp is only its solar component.

nd775e2a926f.s: How many km of National Highways per lakh population does Andhra Pradesh have?
nd775e2a926f.x: Andhra Pradesh has 17.64 km of NH per lakh population against India's 12.09 km, so it is above the national average.

n169c2b0d8f8.s: How many Multimodal Logistics Parks are planned in India, with Jogighopa in Assam as an example?
n169c2b0d8f8.x: Thirty-five Multimodal Logistics Parks are planned; Jogighopa is an example in Assam.

nc7c647dc512.s: Which major port handled the most cargo in FY 2026?
nc7c647dc512.x: Deendayal Port led with 160.11 MT in FY 2026, followed by Paradip and JNPA.

ne2fdd6f3dc5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the LEADS index?
o: It is modelled on the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index
ne2fdd6f3dc5.x: LEADS (DPIIT, 2018) is modelled on the World Bank LPI but combines perception and objective data, so 'only objective data' is wrong.

nworld-geography-17-7.s: Which country has the world's third-longest railway network, about 105,000 km?
nworld-geography-17-7.x: Russia's network is the third-longest at about 105,000 km, after the USA and China.

new.s: Producer gas is a mixture of:
new.x: Producer gas is CO + H2 + N2; water gas is CO + H2 and LPG is propane + butane.

new.s: Green hydrogen is produced by:
o: Natural gas with carbon capture and storage
new.x: Green hydrogen comes from RE-powered electrolysis; hydrogen from gas with CCS is blue hydrogen.

new.s: India's National Solar Mission comes under:
o: National Action Plan on Climate Change
new.x: The National Solar Mission is one of the missions under the NAPCC.

new.s: As of December 2025, which State was first in India in gross installed power capacity and renewable energy capacity?
new.x: Gujarat was first in gross installed capacity and in RE capacity (42.58 GW, 16.5%) in December 2025.

new.s: India's estimated geothermal energy potential is about:
new.x: India has a geothermal potential of about 10,600 MW; it is potential only, not installed capacity.

new.s: As of 31 December 2025, nuclear power formed about what share of India's installed power capacity?
new.x: Nuclear capacity of 8,780 MW was 1.71% of installed capacity; it gives about 3% of generation.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about India's power sector:
1. Thermal power has the highest share of installed capacity.
2. Non-fossil sources form over 50% of installed capacity.
3. India ranks 3rd in the world in wind power capacity.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Thermal has the highest share (48.07%) and non-fossil sources reached 51.93%; India is 4th, not 3rd, in wind capacity.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Indian coal:
1. Gondwana coal is 250-300 million years old.
2. Tertiary coal is found mainly in the Damodar valley.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Gondwana coal is 250-300 million years old and the Damodar valley is its largest field; Tertiary coal (15-60 million years) is in the North-East.

new.s: Tertiary coal in India is found mainly in:
new.x: Tertiary coal occurs in the North-East; the Damodar, Mahanadi and Godavari valleys have Gondwana coal.

new.s: The Korba coalfield is located in:
new.x: Korba coalfield is in Chhattisgarh.

new.s: The Karanpura coalfield is in which State?
new.x: Bokaro, Giridih, Karanpura and Ramgarh coalfields are in Jharkhand.

new.s: Which company is the world's largest coal producer?
new.x: Coal India Limited is the world's largest coal producer; NLC India mines Neyveli lignite.

new.s: The first lignite-fired thermal power station in South-East Asia was at:
new.x: Neyveli in Tamil Nadu had the first lignite-fired thermal power station in South-East Asia.

new.s: Which State has the largest coal reserves in India?
new.x: Jharkhand has the largest coal reserves but no major lignite; Tamil Nadu leads in lignite.

new.s: The KG-D6 gas block of Andhra Pradesh lies in which basin?
new.x: KG-D6 lies in the Krishna-Godavari (KG) basin of Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: The Kalol oil field of Gujarat lies in which basin?
new.x: Ankleshwar and Kalol are in the Cambay basin of Gujarat.

new.s: Which of the following refinery – year of commissioning pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Mathura dates from 1982; Koyali is 1965, Haldia 1975 and Noonmati 1962.

new.s: The Visakhapatnam refinery is operated by:
new.x: Visakhapatnam refinery belongs to HPCL; Tatipaka in AP is an ONGC mini refinery.

new.s: Which country has the largest natural gas reserves in the world?
new.x: Russia has the largest gas reserves; the USA is the top producer and Qatar a major LNG exporter.

new.s: Phase-II of India's Strategic Petroleum Reserves is at Padur and:
new.x: Phase-II SPRs are at Chandikhol and Padur; Ankleshwar was not selected.

new.s: India's Strategic Petroleum Reserves at Padur, Visakhapatnam and Mangaluru hold about:
new.x: The SPRs hold about 5.33 MMT, roughly 9.5 days of requirement.

new.s: The Singrauli Super Thermal Power Station is located in which district?
new.x: Singrauli STPS is in Sonbhadra (UP); Vindhyachal, India's largest, is in Singrauli district (MP).

new.s: Which of the following thermal power station – district pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Sipat is in Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh); Tanda is in Ambedkar Nagar, Kahalgaon in Bhagalpur and Kudgi in Vijayapura.

new.s: Mundra, India's second-largest thermal power station (4,620 MW), is in:
new.x: Mundra is in Kutch, Gujarat, second only to Vindhyachal (4,760 MW).

new.s: The Kothagudem thermal power station is in which State?
new.x: Kothagudem is in Telangana, not Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: India's first hydropower station (1897) was at:
new.x: Sidrapong (Darjeeling, 1897) was the first; Shivasamudram on the Kaveri was the second oldest.

new.s: Most of India's hydel potential lies in the Himalayan basins mainly because their rivers are:
o: Snow-fed and perennial, with steep slopes
new.x: Himalayan rivers are snow-fed and perennial and fall steeply, suiting large dams; Peninsular rivers are seasonal.

new.s: The Xiluodu hydropower project of China is on which river?
new.x: Xiluodu is on the Jinsha, not the Yangtze, on which Three Gorges stands.

new.s: NHPC was set up in:
new.x: NHPC was set up in 1975.

new.s: The Kovvada nuclear power project in Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh, is planned with which country?
new.x: Kovvada is with the USA (AP1000); Kudankulam is with Russia and Jaitapur with France.

new.s: Which of the following nuclear power project – partner country pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Jaitapur is planned with France (six EPRs); Kudankulam is with Russia, Kovvada with the USA and Tarapur has US reactors.

new.s: Haripur, a proposed nuclear power site, is in which State?
new.x: Haripur is in West Bengal, not Haryana.

new.s: Stage II of India's three-stage nuclear programme is based on:
new.x: Stage II uses fast breeders fuelled by plutonium, which breed more fuel than they use.

new.s: The Jaduguda uranium mine is located in:
new.x: Jaduguda and Narwapahar are in Singhbhum, Jharkhand; Tummalapalle is in AP.

new.s: Which country is the world's top producer of uranium?
new.x: Kazakhstan produces about 40% of world uranium; Australia has the largest reserves.

new.s: India's thorium reserves are about what share of the world's?
new.x: India's ~3.6 lakh t of thorium is about 25% of world reserves, the third largest.

new.s: The Tarapur nuclear power station uses which type of reactors?
new.x: Tarapur (1969) has US boiling water reactors, not VVERs.

new.s: The Pavagada solar park (2,050 MW) is in which State?
new.x: Pavagada is in Karnataka; Bhadla is in Rajasthan, Khavda in Gujarat and Rewa in MP.

new.s: The International Solar Alliance was launched at:
new.x: India and France launched the ISA at COP21 in Paris in 2015; its HQ is at Gurugram.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh completed Phase-I of the Green Energy Corridor in December 2025 with funding from:
new.x: AP finished Phase-I of the Green Energy Corridor, funded by KfW, in December 2025.

new.s: Which State leads India in rooftop solar?
new.x: Gujarat leads India in rooftop solar.

new.s: The Pinnapuram pumped storage project in Kurnool has a capacity of:
new.x: Pinnapuram (Greenko) is 1,680 MW; Upper Sileru is 1,350 MW.

new.s: The Kurnool Ultra Mega Solar Park is located at:
new.x: The 1,000 MW Kurnool Ultra Mega Solar Park is at Panyam.

new.s: The NP Kunta (Ananthapuramu) Ultra Mega Solar Park lies in which district?
new.x: NP Kunta solar park is in Sri Sathya Sai district.

new.s: The Rayalaseema Thermal Power Station is located at:
new.x: Rayalaseema TPS (1,050 MW) is at Kalamalla in YSR Kadapa district.

new.s: NTPC's Simhadri Super Thermal Power Station has a capacity of:
new.x: Simhadri (Visakhapatnam/Anakapalli) is 2,000 MW and uses seawater.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about thermal power in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Dr Narla Tata Rao TPS was AP's largest thermal station as of April 2025.
2. Sri Damodaram Sanjeevaiah TPS is at Krishnapatnam, Nellore.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Dr Narla Tata Rao TPS (2,560 MW) was AP's largest thermal station in April 2025, and Sri Damodaram Sanjeevaiah TPS (2,400 MW) is at Krishnapatnam.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about energy in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Pinnapuram pumped storage is in Kurnool
new.x: Kovvada is a nuclear power site, not a coal mine; AP lost its coal mines after bifurcation.

new.s: Rail density in India is lowest in which region?
new.x: Rail density is highest in Punjab, Haryana and the Ganga plains and lowest in the North-East, Himalaya and Thar.

new.s: In 2019, which State ranked second in road density, after Kerala?
new.x: The road density order was Kerala, Punjab, Gujarat and Haryana.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about PMGSY eligibility:
1. Habitations in plain areas need a population of 500+.
2. Habitations in North-East, hill and tribal areas need 250+.
3. Habitations in LWE areas need 250+.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: PMGSY eligibility is 500+ in plains, 250+ in NE, hill and tribal areas and 100+ in LWE areas.

new.s: With Aizawl joining the rail map in September 2025, it became which North-Eastern capital on the railway network?
new.x: Aizawl was the 4th NE capital on rail after Guwahati, Agartala and Itanagar.

new.s: PMGSY was launched on:
new.x: PMGSY was launched on 25 December 2000 as a fully funded Centrally Sponsored Scheme.

new.s: When launched, PM GatiShakti brought together how many ministries?
new.x: GatiShakti began with 16 ministries; its Empowered Group of Secretaries now has 23.

new.s: The East-West Corridor runs between:
new.x: The East-West Corridor is Silchar-Porbandar, not Dibrugarh-Surat.

new.s: The Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor is funded by:
new.x: The Eastern DFC (Ludhiana-Sonnagar) is World Bank funded; the Western DFC is JICA funded.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's freight corridors?
o: The Eastern DFC runs from Ludhiana to Sonnagar
The Western DFC is funded by JICA
The Sonnagar-Dankuni PPP project was a success
The Western DFC runs from Dadri to JNPT
new.x: The Sonnagar-Dankuni PPP is described as a failed project; the other statements are correct.

new.s: The Guntakal-Ballari 3rd and 4th lines link Rayalaseema mainly to:
new.x: The Guntakal-Ballari lines link Rayalaseema to Karnataka and Goa and to Krishnapatnam and Ramayapatnam ports.

new.s: Last-mile rail links to which AP industrial nodes are still incomplete?
new.x: Rail to the Kopparthy and Orvakal industrial nodes is incomplete, so industry there depends on road.

new.s: The South Coast Railway is India's which railway zone?
new.x: South Coast Railway, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, is the 18th zone, set up under the AP Reorganisation Act 2014.

new.s: India's official estimate of logistics cost for 2023-24 is about what share of GDP?
new.x: The official estimate is 7.97% of GDP (2023-24), debated against the older 13-14% figure.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about logistics indices?
o: The LPI is published by the World Bank
new.x: LEADS ranks Indian States, not countries; the World Bank's LPI ranks countries.

new.s: The National Logistics Policy 2022 aims to bring India into which band of the LPI by 2030?
new.x: NLP 2022 targets a single-digit logistics cost and a top-25 LPI rank by 2030.

new.s: In LEADS 2025, Andhra Pradesh was placed in which tier?
new.x: AP was an Accelerator in LEADS 2025; it was an Achiever among coastal States in LEADS 2023.

new.s: Which was India's leading non-major port by cargo in April-November 2025?
new.x: Krishnapatnam led non-major ports with 41.09 MMT in April-November 2025.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh is India's ______ largest exporting State.
new.x: AP is the 6th largest exporting State, though 1st in tobacco and sea-food exports.

new.s: The 20 new National Waterways proposed in Budget 2026-27 begin with:
new.x: Budget 2026-27 proposes 20 new National Waterways over five years, starting with NW-5 in Odisha.

new.s: Rail's present share of India's freight is about:
new.x: Rail carries about 27% of freight; the National Rail Plan targets 45% by 2030.

new.s: Which country ranks fifth in the world in railway length, at about 49,000 km?
new.x: Canada is 5th with about 49,000 km, after the USA, China, Russia and India.

new.s: Which is the world's highest railway?
new.x: The Qinghai-Tibet railway (Xining-Lhasa) is the highest; the Trans-Siberian is the longest.

new.s: Which of the following railway – route pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: The Trans-Andean links Chile and Argentina; the Orient Express ran Paris-Istanbul, the Canadian Pacific Montreal-Vancouver and Qinghai-Tibet Xining-Lhasa.

new.s: The world's longest straight railway track (478 km) lies on the:
new.x: The Trans-Australian line across the Nullarbor has the world's longest straight track, 478 km.

new.s: Canada's first transcontinental railway, the Canadian Pacific, was completed in:
new.x: The Canadian Pacific (Montreal-Vancouver) was completed in 1885; the US transcontinental was 1869.
